rationale: All five candidates transcribe the text without character errors or invented content, and all five omit the underlines that mark the grammar points. The ranking therefore rests on formatting alone: C, D and E are identical and best because they mark the title as a heading and separate paragraphs, so their order among themselves is arbitrary. B separates paragraphs but has no heading, and A has neither a heading nor blank lines between paragraphs.
